_about: hc-1078 / hc-1082: the first line of a multi-bot assistant's SOUL.md and how a rename rewrites it. Read by apps/desktop/src/store/single-thread-bot-ops.test.ts (TypeScript writer, shared/apex-bot-soul.ts) and by the hc-1082 Python rename tool's tests. Change it only together with both writers. Line endings are unified to \n before matching; a rename returns the unified text. null = not this shape (a hand-written line): leave the SOUL alone.

division._about: hc-1079: a new assistant's SOUL.md after its first-open answers, hc-1078's template with the 「分工」 section at the end, then renamed. Read by apps/desktop/src/app/single-thread/bot-intake-soul.test.ts (soul is what Desktop writes for these answers; 撤销 on the renamed file leaves undone, the renamed template) and by tests/apex_overlay/test_assistant_name_division.py (hc-1082's rename rewrites the first line only and keeps the section byte for byte). Change it only together with those writers.

cases.division:
## 分工

用户第一次打开你时定的（用户这次说的不一样时以这次为准）：
- 主要帮用户：剪辑出片
- 说话风格：简短直接。先说结论，少铺垫。
- 主要给哪个平台做：跟 APEX 一样，按用户画像里的主要发布平台
